# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes a dressed-up [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in a buggy and visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) out of curiosity. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and concern over the risks of adoption before departing to spread the news.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy, only to learn from the stationmaster that a girl was left for him instead. Shy [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to take the talkative orphan girl back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) rather than leaving her behind, listening to her enthusiastic chatter along the way.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the girl past the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and Barry's pond as she talks animatedly and renames the sights along the way. Upon arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dreads having her learn about the mistake regarding her adoption.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P56](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P77](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0077)_

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears when she realizes she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight in the east gable room. After putting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending her back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests they might keep her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Snow Queen** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding landscape from her window before being told by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to dress and come down for breakfast. After eating with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and a quiet [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) washes the dishes and names Marilla's geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return arrangements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P8](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027)_

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their drive along the shore road to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to recount her life story. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her orphaned childhood, her time taking care of children for Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and her stay at the orphanage, causing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to feel sudden pity for the unloved girl and consider letting her stay.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P16](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)_

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to clarify the adoption mix-up, where Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant. Seeing Anne's distress and disliking Mrs. Blewett's harsh nature, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay with them, resolving to raise her properly.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P12](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P4](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P28](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0028)_

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to learn the Lord's Prayer, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by her daydreams and imaginations. Eventually, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is sent to her bedroom where she finishes learning the prayer and continues daydreaming out her window.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P22](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P53](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0053)_

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. Lynde before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. Lynde leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P47](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0047)_

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. Lynde, who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050)_

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, to Anne's disappointment over their lack of puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday-school alone, where she feels out of place in Miss Rogerson's class. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of her day, the lesson, and the church service.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P21](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0021)_

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her mother. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly become friends in the garden, solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her new friend, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of chocolate sweeties.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042)_

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns about an upcoming Sunday-school picnic and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for permission to attend. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to bake her a picnic basket, prompting a rare, affectionate embrace from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) works on her sewing, she chatteringly details her playhouse, [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), and her growing excitement for the picnic.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P7](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P9](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011)_

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of being allowed to go to the Sunday school picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) still forbids her from going. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) soon discovers the brooch snagged in her lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P1](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the Sunday school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed by the day's excitement and ice cream, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later recounts the whole incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P67](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0067), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P69](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0069)_

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — While attending school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is taunted by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who calls her 'Carrots' and pulls her hair. Enraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head, leading Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) to punish her by making her stand at the blackboard. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proudly rejects Gilbert's attempt to apologize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea and raspberry cordial while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attends a meeting. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unintentionally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of home-made currant wine instead of cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become intoxicated and sick. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) via Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) that she accidentally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and is banned from seeing her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P7](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P29](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that she accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to ban [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with her. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to clear up the mistake, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) refuses to listen. Desperate, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) herself to plead for forgiveness, but is coldly turned away.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P57](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0057), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P62](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0062)_

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a tearful goodbye near the spring after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Devastated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, though [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) remains forced to keep her distance. Channeling her emotions into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during the night, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to visit [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly runs over to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) house and later returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about their joyful reconciliation and evening together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P47](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P48](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0048)_

## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert with their classmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), unaware that Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is sleeping in it. The surprise causes [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to react angrily, threatening to cut short her visit and cancel Diana's music lessons until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take responsibility.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) admits her fault to Mrs. Lynde before walking over to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's brave and earnest explanation amuses [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue Diana's music lessons. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) become great friends during her month-long stay.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P79](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0079), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090)_

## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the past year since arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and recounts her imaginative adventures to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses she is terrified of crossing the spruce grove because she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined it was a haunted wood. To break her of this silly fear, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk through the dark woods anyway, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does in sheer terror before returning safely.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P10](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P25](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P34](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0034)_

## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional after Mr. Phillips's farewell speech and eager about the arrival of Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. However, during the tea party, Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice a strange taste in Anne's cake.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035)_

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During tea with Mr. and Mrs. Allan, Anne's homemade cake is discovered to have been accidentally flavored with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects optimistically to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that tomorrow is a new day free of mistakes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P43](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P54](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0054)_

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. Allan. After worrying about her conduct, she returns from the visit in high spirits and happily recounts the evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), including news that [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has hired a new female schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P8](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)_

## CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and flourishes under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, throwing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the other students into excited preparations despite Marilla's skepticism. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), finding steady support and encouragement in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the stylish dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as well as a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). They participate in the evening concert, which is a great success, and walk home together discussing the performances. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire and express their pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), briefly discussing her future education.

When washing the dye out fails, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cuts Anne's hair short, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later resolves to bear the resulting embarrassment as penance.

## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), floating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the pond in a leaky boat. After the boat sinks, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clings to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her, though she refuses his offer of friendship. Back home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning not to be overly romantic, but [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently encourages her to keep a bit of romance in her life.

They spend several exciting days enjoying the fair, visiting the park, and attending a concert before Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) drives them back home.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid farewell to [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reflects warmly on Anne's pleasant presence. The girls enjoy their scenic evening drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. ## CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) wants to prepare her for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to pay for the extra schooling, which fulfills a dream for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later joins the newly formed Queen's class at school alongside her classmates, though she feels saddened that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) will not be joining them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return next year to prepare the class for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts away her books for the summer to enjoy her childhood, while Mrs. Lynde visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises Anne's remarkable growth and improvement over the past three years.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P36](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P37](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P2](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results of the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. Lynde before going to sleep feeling grateful.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P38](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P41](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P45](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0045)_

## CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — Following her successful recitation and encore at the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is warmly praised by the guests, including a stout pink lady and Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for supper before they leave with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) in his carriage, chatting about wealth, compliments from an artist, and being content with who they are.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who grows emotional reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) means to them. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to her new living arrangements and classes, feeling a mix of rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and homesickness. Her spirits are lifted when [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit, bringing news that Queen's will award an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P0](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)_

## CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — At Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students settle into their hard work as the school year progresses, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflecting on her softened rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As spring arrives and final examinations approach, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, and [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to anxiously discuss exams and commencement plans, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds comfort in nature and her future dreams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery Scholarship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, and she subsequently celebrates her success at commencement with her loved ones. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconnects with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and learns that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) plans to teach locally instead of attending [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She also notes signs of aging and ill health in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), enjoying a serene evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) in the pasture before hardship strikes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)_

## CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), Green Gables, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P19](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)_

## CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing eyesight will force her to sell [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let her sell, giving up her college scholarship to stay home, teach, and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. Lynde later reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach close to home, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII.
